sloka: ततो महीतले राम पर्यक्रामत रावणः ।क्षत्ऺित्रयान्सुमहावीर्यान्बाधमान इतस्ततः ।। ७.१६.४८ ॥
transliteration: tato mahītale rāma paryakrāmata rāvaṇaḥ ।kṣatऺitrayānsumahāvīryānbādhamāna itastataḥ ।। 7.16.48 ॥

translations.english: Then, O Rama, Ravana roamed about on the earth's surface, harassing very mighty Kshatriyas here and there.
